title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Bradley University
description: Discover the essential late-night food stops and campus rituals that fuel Bradley University students during late study sessions and weekend gatherings in Peoria.

cards.title: Jumbo Slices at SliceHub
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Pizza on Bradley Avenue
cards.notes: Grab a massive 30-inch jumbo slice at this corner spot. It is a primary destination for students seeking hot food until 3:00 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: A local pizzeria known for oversized slices and late-night availability near the campus edge.
cards.evidence_claim: SliceHub Pizzeria is open for pickup and delivery until 3:00 AM every day of the week.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM daily for walk-in pickup and delivery.

cards.title: Midnight Burritos at Moe's
cards.subtitle: Tex-Mex in the Michel Student Center
cards.notes: Visit the Student Center for burritos and free chips. This campus staple serves students until midnight most nights during the semester.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus Tex-Mex restaurant located within the Michel Student Center offering late-night dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Moe's Southwest Grill at Bradley University is open until 12:00 AM Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Michel Student Center; open until midnight daily.

cards.title: After-Hours at Williams
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Coffee and Study Space
cards.notes: Utilize the newly renovated dining hall's after-hours coffee shop for late-night caffeine and quiet study sessions on campus.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall featuring a dedicated after-hours coffee shop and expanded study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated Williams Dining Hall includes an after-hours coffee shop and additional study spaces for students.
cards.source_title: What's new at BU - The Bradley Scout
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students with meal plans or campus IDs; features late-night coffee service.

cards.title: Evening Coffee at One World
cards.subtitle: Eclectic Dining on Main Street
cards.notes: Enjoy globally inspired flavors in an artistic setting. It is a long-standing student favorite for evening meals and coffee near campus.
cards.short_summary: A popular local cafe near Bradley University known for its diverse menu and artistic atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: One World Cafe is open until 8:00 PM Monday through Saturday, serving a full menu and coffee all day.
cards.access_notes: Located at the corner of Main and University; open until 8:00 PM most nights.

cards.title: Freaky Fast Subs on Main
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Sandwiches Near Campus
cards.notes: Order a sub for a quick late-night meal. This location serves the Bradley community with late-night delivery and pickup options.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich shop located on Main Street providing quick meals and late-night delivery for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jimmy John's at 1121 W Main St is open until 10:00 PM daily for late-night meals.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop & Gourmet Subs in Peoria | Jimmy John's 3289
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM daily for in-store pickup and delivery.

cards.title: Late Night BU Activities
cards.subtitle: Alcohol-Free Friday Night Fun
cards.notes: Attend these university-hosted events for free food from local vendors, games, and activities in the Markin Center on select Fridays.
cards.short_summary: A signature university program providing alcohol-free entertainment and food for students late on Friday nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Night BU is a signature event that includes food from local restaurants and activities for students on campus.
cards.access_notes: Events typically held on Friday nights in the Markin Center; check campus calendar for dates.

cards.title: Midnight Study at Cullom-Davis
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Resources and Snacks
cards.notes: Study until midnight in the campus library. Vending machines provide quick snacks for students during intensive late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary university library offering late-night study hours and vending options for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Cullom-Davis Library is open until 12:00 AM Sunday through Thursday for student study sessions.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spaces On and Around Bradley - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM Sunday-Thursday; requires student ID for late entry.

cards.title: Philly Steaks at Campustown
cards.subtitle: Quick Bites in Campustown Center
cards.notes: Stop by for a signature Philly steak or gyro. This Campustown eatery is a convenient stop for students until 8:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: A local sandwich shop in the Campustown Shopping Center known for its steaks, fries, and gyros.
cards.evidence_claim: Steak & Fries in Campustown is open Monday through Saturday from 11:00 AM to 8:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Campustown Shopping Center; open until 8:30 PM Monday-Saturday.

cards.title: Evening Pho at Thanh Linh
cards.subtitle: Authentic Vietnamese on Main Street
cards.notes: Warm up with a bowl of noodle soup or bubble tea. This restaurant is a staple for students seeking authentic Vietnamese flavors in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned Vietnamese restaurant near campus offering traditional dishes and bubble tea.
cards.evidence_claim: Thanh Linh Vietnamese Restaurant is open until 8:30 PM Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:30 PM daily except Sundays.

cards.title: Late Snacks at the Marketplace
cards.subtitle: Convenience in the Student Center
cards.notes: Pick up grab-and-go snacks or deli items late into the night. It serves as a primary on-campus convenience option for residential students.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus deli and market providing convenient food options until midnight for the Bradley community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marketplace Deli in the Michel Student Center is open until 12:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: New time to eat: Dining services changes operating hours - The Bradley Scout
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Michel Student Center; open until midnight daily.
